title: Crocodile: candidates to choose from
note: Four sounds for the lake's crocodile, with up to three choices each. All are recordings, CC0, from OpenGameArt. Say which letter you like for each (for example: warning A, bite C, splash B, hit A). Each plays at the level the game would start it at; the mix can be set later.

sounds.label: Crocodile warning A: real bear growl
sounds.what: The tell before it lunges: about a second of a real bear's low growl (a recording of a wild animal). The most real of the three.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Bear Growls" by AntumDeluge (from the U.S. Fish & Wildlife Service), from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile warning B: deep monster growl
sounds.what: The tell before it lunges: a short, deep growl made by voice (roar_04). Less real, more like a cartoon creature.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "80 CC0 creture SFX #2" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile warning C: low bubbling gurgle
sounds.what: The tell before it lunges: a second of deep bubbling in a swamp, as if something big is breathing out under the water. The gentlest of the three.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Swamp Environment Audio" by LokiF, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile bite A: rush into a hit
sounds.what: The lunge: a rushing sound that builds to a sharp hit (attack_02).
sounds.credit: Recorded: "80 CC0 creture SFX #2" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile bite B: chomp
sounds.what: The bite alone: a quick crunchy chomp, made by voice. Short (a quarter of a second), with no rush through the water before it.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Crunchy bite" by fvcalderan, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile bite C: water surge then a wooden snap
sounds.what: The lunge: a short surge of water (a bottle of water swung) with a hard wooden clack on top as the jaws shut. Two recordings put together.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "10 Slime/Water Monster/Water" by StarNinjas and "80 CC0 RPG SFX" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile splash A: big fat splash
sounds.what: A heavy thing hitting the water: a cannonball landing in the sea, cut to one second.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "Ocean splash" by Thimras, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile splash B: deep splash
sounds.what: A deep, heavy splash from the same pack as the hero's splash (splash_04), lower and fuller than the hero's.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile splash C: thrashing splash
sounds.what: Several splashes close together, like a tail thrashing (splash_11).
sounds.credit: Recorded: "40 CC0 water / splash / slime SFX" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile hit A: dull thump
sounds.what: A hero lands on the crocodile: a dull, low thump (bfh1_hit_07). No voice.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "75 CC0 breaking / falling / hit sfx" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile hit B: thump and a grunt
sounds.what: A hero lands on the crocodile: a thump with a short, low pained grunt on top. Two recordings put together.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "75 CC0 breaking / falling / hit sfx" and "80 CC0 RPG SFX" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.

sounds.label: Crocodile hit C: wet slap
sounds.what: A hero lands on the crocodile: a wet, heavy slap (made in mud), for a creature that is wet all over.
sounds.credit: Recorded: "25 CC0 mud sfx" by rubberduck, from OpenGameArt. CC0.
